articles.title: ISRO Completes Initial Design Phase for Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS-1) Module
articles.summary: ISRO advances indigenous space station development with finalized designs for the BAS-1 core module set for upcoming testing phases.
prelims: BAS-1 is the foundational primary module of India's planned Bharatiya Antariksha Station targeted for full assembly by 2035.
The module utilizes indigenous Environmental Control and Life Support Systems (ECLSS) and automated docking mechanisms.
The modified LVM3 heavy-lift launch vehicle will serve as the primary carrier for station core modules.
articles.mains: Examine the strategic and technological significance of establishing a sovereign space station for India's long-term deep-space exploration roadmap.

articles.title: Cabinet Finalizes Operational Framework for Indian Carbon Market (ICM)
articles.summary: The Ministry of Power and BEE issue detailed compliance metrics and credit registry protocols under the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme.
prelims: Notified under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, replacing the legacy Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) scheme for obligated sectors.
Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) acts as the administrator, while Grid Controller of India operates the registry.
Establishes dual mechanisms: a mandatory compliance market for energy-intensive sectors and a voluntary offset market.
articles.mains: Critically analyze how the Indian Carbon Market can enable India to meet its NDC commitments under the Paris Agreement without hampering industrial growth.

articles.title: BIMSTEC Maritime Transport Cooperation Agreement Finalized in Dhaka
articles.summary: BIMSTEC member nations approve a common framework to streamline port logistics, coastal shipping protocols, and maritime safety.
prelims: BIMSTEC comprises 7 member states: 5 from South Asia (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka) and 2 from Southeast Asia (Myanmar, Thailand).
The agreement grants reciprocal access to commercial vessels and harmonizes customs clearance across Bay of Bengal ports.
The permanent BIMSTEC Secretariat is headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
articles.mains: Discuss how strengthening BIMSTEC operational capacity aligns with India's 'Neighbourhood First' and 'Act East' foreign policy objectives.

articles.title: National Disaster Management Authority Issues Guidelines on Himalayan GLOF Mitigation
articles.summary: NDMA mandates real-time automated monitoring networks for high-vulnerability glacial lakes across the Himalayan region.
prelims: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) occur when natural moraine dams retaining glacial meltwater collapse catastrophically.
High-altitude lakes across Sikkim, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand have been prioritized for automated sensor installation.
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) remote sensing technology is utilized to detect surface area changes in high-altitude lakes.
articles.mains: Evaluate the vulnerability of the Indian Himalayan Region to climate-induced disaster risks and suggest integrated disaster risk reduction measures.

articles.title: Election Commission Rolls Out AI-Driven Electoral Roll Reconciliation System
articles.summary: ECI deploys advanced cross-referencing technology to eliminate duplicate voter enrollments across inter-state boundaries.
prelims: Article 324 of the Constitution vests the superintendence, direction, and control of electoral roll preparation in the Election Commission.
The system complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act guidelines to ensure voter privacy.
Facilitates seamless voter registration transfers for inter-state migrant populations without physical re-verification delay.
articles.mains: Assess the potential of emerging technologies in modernizing electoral administration in India while ensuring data security and constitutional safeguards.
